Typed nulls need no fabricated resource state. Pending reset and caller retirement retain all original state, buffer and slot owners until that exact receipt completes or safely drains.

Four two-draw DEFAULT-table scenarios per fixture repetition prove independent consumed state, post-Close descriptor changes, real nonzero uniform bits, zero nulls, no-attempt failure/retry and detached pending state lifetime. The preserved pre-fix DLL fails the valid DEFAULT-table execution. This is not public Windows D3D12/native GPU qualification.
native_cbv_table_default_states.remaining: The full public runtime, native GPU qualification, general state persistence/promotion across command lists, broader resources, SRV/UAV/sampler/image table classes, arrays/dynamic indexing and complete shader semantics remain unfinished.

genuine_sampler_descriptor_objects.state: All point/linear min/mag/mip combinations and comparison variants, standard float border colors, wrap/mirror/clamp/border/mirror-once and finite ordered LOD state are normalized. Ignored comparison/anisotropy/border fields preserve their raw metadata without enabling unused Vulkan state. Reduction filtering, arbitrary custom/integer border variants and complete sampler/shader combinations remain unfinished.
genuine_sampler_descriptor_objects.backend: Exact selected maxSamplerLodBias, maxSamplerAnisotropy and maxSamplerAllocationCount are cached. Both real create/destroy procedures must exist before constructing anything. A bounded atomic selected-device quota covers independent cleanup/create overlap. genuine_sampler_descriptor_objects.lifetime_copy: Heap operation and device-child claims pin all constructor/copy/rollback/destructor work. Each sampler copy owns an independently constructed immutable VkSampler; all candidates are prepared before any destination changes. Source retirement cannot invalidate copies. Mistyped/stale/out-of-range destinations, shader-visible copy sources, overlap, duplicate destinations and uninitialized sources refuse before construction. Partial create failure destroys only new prepared objects and preserves every prior generation. Cleanup destroys actual objects before releasing protected arenas and parent claims.
genuine_sampler_descriptor_objects.evidence: All31 isolated ABI/model regressions pass. An independent model validates actual Vulkan enums, enabled features, bounds and sampler lifecycle. Matrices exercise normal/comparison filtering, standard borders, optional/limited anisotropy and LOD, ignored raw bits, explicit four-byte records, missing procedures, failed undefined outputs, partial atomic copies and blocked-constructor snapshot/heap/device ownership. The otherwise identical control with the old eight-byte guard fails the explicit valid four-byte case. Genuine inventory is66 core/36 list/3 queue pointers; pointer availability is not functional public qualification.
